newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian OTC market says to switch to kuna pricing.
newsitem.headline: Croatian OTC market says to switch to kuna pricing.

text.p: The Croatian over-the-counter market in Varazdin said on Friday it would switch to the local kuna currency pricing from German marks next year.
In a statement faxed to Reuters it invited all brokers to convert prices on their orders into kuna before January 2.
Any standing orders that are not changed or withdrawn before then, will be converted automatically at the central bank's midrate on December 31.
